package_name: Spiti Village Circuit (5D) — Langza, Hikkim, Komic & Kibber

itinerary.day_1: Kaza Acclimatisation (Drive: Local). Places: Kaza, Key Monastery. Activities: Kaza town walk; Key Monastery sunset; Acclimatisation rest (3,800m).
itinerary.day_2: Langza & Hikkim (Drive: 40 km). Places: Langza Village, Hikkim. Activities: Langza marine fossils (4,400m); Hikkim post office (world's highest); Buddha statue viewpoint.
itinerary.day_3: Komic & Kibber (Drive: 30 km). Places: Komic, Kibber Village. Activities: Komic gompa (4,587m); Kibber village wildlife walk; Snow leopard habitat zone.
itinerary.day_4: Pin Valley (Drive: 50 km). Places: Pin Valley National Park, Tabo Monastery. Activities: Pin-Bhaba valley entry; Mud village walk; Dhankar Monastery.
itinerary.day_5: Kaza → Manali (Drive: Via Kunzum). Places: Kunzum Pass. Activities: Kunzum goddess temple; Atal Tunnel crossing; Manali arrival.
